clips.prompt: Subject: a shy 10-year-old girl (straight black bob with blunt bangs, large dark-brown eyes, small mole under left eye, red-and-white yukata with goldfish pattern, fox-faced paper lantern in her left hand) and her 6-year-old brother (short spiky black hair, big ears, blue happi coat with white wave print, cheeky gap-toothed grin). Motion: the boy tugs free and darts frame-right into the crowd; the girl turns after him. Dialogue: the boy says "Look, the drums! I want to see!" excited and tugging away; the girl calls "Kenji, wait -- stay close!" worried. Scene: narrow festival street, strings of red paper lanterns overhead, wooden stalls with warm glow, banners with wave motifs, dense yukata crowd, indigo night sky. Spatial: girl center-left facing the stall, boy at her right hand exiting frame-right, 180-degree line along the stall front. Camera: slow dolly push-in 30cm toward the girl, ending close on her alarmed face. Warm lantern key light frame-right, cool night rim frame-left, painterly Ghibli-esque style, festival drums and crowd murmur swelling.
